component.name: WorkerTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "drain" m.port = CreateObject("roMessagePort") m.top.observeField("request", m.port) end sub
sub drain() m.top.ready = true small = 0 big = 0 for attempt = 0 to 300 msg = wait(100, m.port) if type(msg) = "roSGNodeEvent" if len(msg.getData()) > 1000000 then big++ else small++ if small + big = 100 then exit for end if end for m.top.report = "small=" + small.toStr() + " big=" + big.toStr() end sub
